prompt:
The section sections/podcast-episode-list.liquid lists podcast episodes. The markup carries a current_season variable across loop iterations. When an episode block's season differs from the previous one, it closes the previous <ol>, prints a season heading and opens a new <ol>. Because this comparison is numeric, the season setting must be a number setting. The markup is correct and must not be changed. The {% schema %} JSON is incomplete. Replace the schema so the file ends in exactly one {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block whose JSON equals the following, with keys and array entries in this order:

Top level: "name": "Podcast episodes", "tag": "section", "class": "section-podcast", "max_blocks": 20, then "settings", "blocks" and "presets".

settings, in this order:
1. type "text", id "title", label "Title", default "Latest episodes".
2. type "text", id "season_prefix", label "Season prefix", default "Season".
3. type "select", id "layout", label "Layout", options [{"value": "list", "label": "List"}, {"value": "grid", "label": "Grid"}] in that order, default "list".

blocks: exactly one block type. type "episode", name "Episode". Its settings, in this order:
1. type "text", id "episode_title", label "Episode title", default "New episode".
2. type "number", id "season", label "Season number", default 1. The default is the JSON number 1, not a string.
3. type "text", id "duration", label "Duration", default "30:00".
4. type "url", id "audio_url", label "Audio link". No default.
5. type "checkbox", id "explicit", label "Explicit content", default false.

presets: exactly one preset. name "Podcast episodes". blocks contains three entries, each {"type": "episode"}.

Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/podcast-episode-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
